scope_note: The official stenographic report of the extraordinary Third Congress, volume I, as a page-image scan (426 PDF pages; the file's metadata names pdfcpu, and the page images carry a text layer). The second sitting of 12 March 1990 (printed pp. 58 and 98) and the third sitting of 13 March 1990 (printed pp. 104 and 133-137) were read for the Soyuz group; the volume's vote lists name the group's speakers only as voters and are not imported. The scan is hosted by the non-official SSSR.SU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file (live_file_response).

edition_and_host.edition: Внеочередной третий съезд народных депутатов СССР, 12-15 марта 1990 г. Стенографический отчет. Том I. Издание Верховного Совета СССР, Москва, 1990 (title page, PDF p. 3); imprint (PDF p. 424): 'Сдано в набор 21.05.90. Подписано к печати 12.09.90', 'Тираж 17000 экз.', typeset in Tula and printed in Tashkent; 426 PDF pages, printed p. N on PDF p. N + 2 for the cited pages.

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; the sitting headings, speaker lines and quotations were compared with the image, and the title page and imprint were read for the edition.

persons_named: М. С. Горбачев (Председатель Верховного Совета СССР, presiding)
rows.role_title_as_printed: The passage names neither the speaker nor any office in the group.
rows.text: At the second sitting (Kremlin Palace of Congresses, 12 March 1990, 16:00, 'Председательствует Председатель Верховного Совета СССР М. С. Горбачев') a deputy speaking from the floor says: 'Я выступаю от имени депутатской группы «Союз», представитель которой тоже записан в числе выступающих, ему тоже должны дать слово.'
rows.locator: Second sitting: heading, printed p. 58 (PDF p. 60); remark, printed p. 98 (PDF p. 100)

persons_named: М. С. Горбачев (Председатель Верховного Совета СССР, presiding)
rows.role_title_as_printed: The passage prints no office in the group for the speaker.
rows.text: At the third sitting (Kremlin Palace of Congresses, 13 March 1990, 10:00, 'Председательствует Председатель Верховного Совета СССР М. С. Горбачев') the presiding officer gives the floor 'от имени депутатской группы «Союз» — депутату Блохину'; 'Блохин Ю. В., заместитель Председателя Комитета Верховного Совета СССР по вопросам экономической реформы' makes 'заявление депутатской группы «Союз»' on the situation in Lithuania.
rows.locator: Third sitting: heading, printed p. 104 (PDF p. 106); presiding officer, speaker line and statement, printed p. 133 (PDF p. 135)

rows.role_title_as_printed: The passage prints no office in the group for the speaker.
rows.text: In the same speech 'Блохин Ю. В.' reports the questions 'обсуждены на состоявшемся в преддверии Съезда собрании депутатской группы «Союз» по обсуждаемому законопроекту' on the presidency, and that 'По итогам собрания в его резолюции были названы три альтернативы на пост Президента СССР'.

rows.role_title_as_printed: The passage prints no office in the group for the speaker.
rows.text: Asked by the presiding officer to say 'два слова о вашей группе, поскольку им неизвестна такая группа', 'Блохин Ю. В.' says that the newspapers ignored the group and, when a list of its members is requested, answers: 'Сейчас в составе депутатской группы «Союз» более 300 человек.'

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
